Bare arms and bare hands, natural athletic adult proportions, same face and outfit in all cells. The reference is identity/clothes only, not a grid to duplicate. Simple/light/crouch/aerial/ledgeAttack follow the actual wooden-stake technique. NATIVE CORRECTIVE STRIP. Transparent RGBA, exactly FOUR COLUMNS and 4 ROWS. Every cell is a NEW complete anatomically distinct hand-drawn body. Reference is outfit/face only; do not copy its poses. All cells and sword/stake tips have generous transparent gutters, no floor/platform/grid/text. Keep one consistent upright anatomical source pixel scale across all rows; crouched/airborne poses keep natural smaller projection. Final feet and blade tips MUST be complete and away from canvas edge. No procedural rotations, duplication or effects-only variation. Default facing RIGHT.
ROW1 perfectShield: four real complete standing martial deflections, torso/forearms and feet actually change; short wooden stake right hand parries, no shield. Column0 fully upright with both hands below crown, crown-to-sole calibration. ROW2 jumpApex: four distinct compact airborne apex poses with different real knee/hip/arm joints, stake sheathed. ROW3 aerialForward: four physical airborne forward stake thrusts in right hand, with different complete leg/torso configurations, no projectile, no victim. ROW4 crouchIdle: four truly LOW stable crouched breathing/body-balance configurations, hands in guard, stake sheathed; do not rise to standing.
No omitted rows. Exactly 16 complete distinct drawings. Four chronological configurations per row, anatomically connected two arms/two legs. Adult modest character, no opponent, no gore.
